question: The Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puruskar 2021, for the identification and nurturing of budding and young talent, was given to ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manav Rachna Educational Institution**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puruskar**

 
 
• An honour given by the Republic of **India in sports is the Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puruskar**.
 
• The** Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports** bestows it annually.
 
• The award honours** "corporates, nonprofits, and sports control boards' role in the promotion and growth of sports in the nation"** over the previous three years.
 
• The award was** launched in 2009, and in 2015, the rules were updated**. 
 
• Since the modification, organisations are awarded in the following four categories: **sports for development, Identification and nurturing of budding and young talent, corporate social responsibility initiatives to promote sports and employment of athletes, and sports welfare programs**.
 
• The Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puruskar 2021, for the identification and nurturing of budding and young talent, was given to **M**anav Rachna Educational Institution.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Sports Promotion Award **is the translation of the award's name into Hindi.
 
• The award was presented to Manav Rachna Educational Institution by the **Hon. Ram Nath Kovind, the former President of India in 2021**.
 
• The Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puruskar 2021,** for the encouragement ****of sports through corporate social responsibility, was given to Oil and Natural Gas Corporation.**
 
• The award is **presented annually at the Presidential Palace by the President of India**, usually on** August 29th of each year**, together with the other **five National Sports Awards and the National Adventure Award**.
